mechanism: Methimazole can cause agranulocytosis and immunosuppression, and loperamide may mask symptoms of toxic megacolon or worsen gastrointestinal complications in patients with compromised immune function.
action: Monitor for signs of infection and gastrointestinal complications; use loperamide cautiously in methimazole-treated patients and consider alternative antidiarrheals if prolonged use is needed.
